feature: Natural momentum and native photo snapping
implementation: The browser owns the complete gesture, momentum and snapping interaction. JavaScript observes visible/settled photos only.

files.momentum-scroll.js: createMomentumScroll(container,{itemSelector,onActiveChange}); refresh() and destroy(). No scripted scrolling.
files.feed.css: Native y mandatory snapping, normal multi-target pass-through, reduced-motion free scrolling.
files.feed.js: Initializes native scrolling, adjacent-image preparation, delayed captions and photo-article dialog; caption controller suspended during article reading.
files.research.json: Nine primary sources, UX audit, design decisions, tradeoffs and validation.

integration: Give the container a fixed height, overflow-y:auto and scroll-snap-type:y mandatory.
Set every adjacent content item to scroll-snap-align:start and scroll-snap-stop:normal; do not force one-item-per-gesture stops.
Keep touch-action:pan-y pinch-zoom, native keyboard access and scroll-behavior:auto.
Import createMomentumScroll and optionally provide onActiveChange({index,item,count}). This callback must not reposition the feed.
For reduced motion, disable compulsory snapping using the provided media query.

behavior.momentum: OS/browser native, velocity responsive on touch and trackpads.
behavior.snap: Native engine uses gesture direction, natural stopping point and visible targets; it may pass multiple items.
behavior.interruption: New input goes directly to the same native engine. There is no application animation to cancel.
behavior.visibility: Predominantly visible item observation prepares neighboring photos; it never overrides native target selection.
behavior.oversized_items: Native CSS snap rules allow scrolling within items larger than the viewport.
behavior.fallback: Without native CSS snapping support the feed remains freely scrollable. IntersectionObserver/scrollend are feature-detected; a legacy timer updates status only.
behavior.reduced_motion: Free native scrolling; no forced alignment or custom animation.

changes_from_v1: Removed fixed 160ms input / 100ms velocity waits and separate spring.
Removed gesture interception and scroll-position writes, including resize-triggered alignment.
Native mandatory snap restores useful small wheel/keyboard movement.
Responsive image candidates and preparation of adjacent images reduce unnecessary loading pressure.

configuration.removed_options: settleSpeed, settleWindow, inputQuiet and frequency belonged to the removed custom spring.

tradeoff: Native snap selection honors direction and projected momentum. A strict instantaneous maximum-visible-target rule is intentionally not forced over native gesture intent.

validation.automated: Six native scrolling,14 caption and18 article tests passed. Native controller unchanged.

test_composition.name: fade + scroll
test_composition.visible_ui: Large title, then Photo study / # and read more >. No feed header, current/total counter or scrolling hint.
test_composition.interaction: Only actual scrolling fades captions out; ordinary clicks and stationary taps preserve captions. Read more explicitly opens the selected photo article.
